Source: Dungeons and Dragon Ballz V.3, PDF page 138. Category: technique. Rank 2.

Rank 2 Ki technique
Ki Cost: 10 per ki blast
Prerequisites: none
Casting Time: 1 action
Range: 120 feet
Chargeable?: No
Duration: Instantaneous
Type: Barrage
Fire a barrage of individual Barrage Attack Roll
dealing your Basic Ki Blast Damage Die each on a hit.
You can not fire more shots then your proficiency
bonus.
